Rapid sea ice decline in the Ross Sea is the target of a pilot project under the Catalyst
Strategic NZ-US Joint Antarctic Research Programme, which got under way on 1 October 2025.
Rodrigo Gomez-Fell joins the project as a postdoctoral researcher. See the
[project description](../projects.qmd#ross-sea-ice).
